evals.prompt: I have a React Native Expo stock-count screen that scans barcodes with expo-camera's CameraView (onBarcodeScanned). I want to replace it with Scandit SparkScan and keep the list with quantities, the total, the Clear button and the torch. Here is my screen: ExpoCameraListScanner.tsx
evals.expected_output: The skill removes expo-camera (CameraView, useCameraPermissions, onBarcodeScanned, barcodeScannerSettings), creates a SparkScan mode with exactly EAN13UPCA and Code128, moves the scan handler into SparkScanListener.didScan reading session.newlyRecognizedBarcode, wraps the existing list UI in SparkScanView, keeps the quantity increment, total and Clear, moves the torch to the SparkScan toolbar control and flags that as a UI change, replaces the permission hook with a PermissionsAndroid request, and shows a setup checklist with the Expo development-build note.

assertions.text: expo-camera is NOT imported in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
CameraView is NOT rendered in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
onBarcodeScanned is NOT used in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
useCameraPermissions is NOT called in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
DataCaptureContext.initialize( is present (v8 API)
DataCaptureContext.sharedInstance is used to obtain the context
new SparkScanSettings() is created and passed to new SparkScan(
settings.enableSymbologies(...) enables exactly Symbology.EAN13UPCA (from 'ean13' and 'upc_a') and Symbology.Code128, and nothing else
Symbology.QRCode does NOT appear as a Symbology enum value
addListener( is called on the SparkScan mode with a didScan callback
The didScan callback is declared async (the 8.6 SparkScanListener returns Promise<void>)
The didScan callback reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and does not loop over an array of barcodes
<SparkScanView is rendered with context, sparkScan and sparkScanViewSettings props
The list, total and Clear button are rendered as children of <SparkScanView> (semantic)
Scanning a code that is already in the list increments its quantity instead of adding a second row (semantic)
The 'Total items:' sum of quantities is preserved in the rendered output
The Clear button empties the list
torchControlVisible is set to true on the SparkScanView (prop or ref)
The summary lists the torch moving from the app's own button to the SparkScan toolbar as a UI change for the user to confirm (semantic)
PermissionsAndroid.request( is used for the camera permission (the old permission hook is gone)
The cleanup removes the listener and calls dataCaptureContext.removeMode( on unmount
dataCaptureContext.dispose() is NOT called anywhere in the code
Setup checklist mentions scandit-react-native-datacapture-core and scandit-react-native-datacapture-barcode
Setup checklist says Scandit does not run in Expo Go and a development build (expo prebuild / expo run:ios / expo run:android) is needed
Setup checklist mentions NSCameraUsageDescription (Info.plist or app.json expo.ios.infoPlist)
A summary of changes is shown listing what was removed and what Scandit code was added

evals.prompt: I have a React Native app that scans barcodes with react-native-vision-camera's built-in code scanner (useCodeScanner). I want to replace it with Scandit SparkScan. Here is my screen: VisionCameraScanner.tsx
evals.expected_output: The skill removes the react-native-vision-camera code scanner (useCodeScanner, Camera, useCameraDevice, useCameraPermission), creates a SparkScan mode with EAN13UPCA, Code128 and QR, moves the handler into SparkScanListener.didScan reading the single session.newlyRecognizedBarcode, wraps the summary list in SparkScanView, preserves the dedupe and the Scanned count, and shows a setup checklist.

assertions.text: react-native-vision-camera is NOT imported in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
useCodeScanner is NOT called in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
The vision-camera Camera component and its codeScanner prop are NOT present in the output code (they may appear in a before/after summary)
DataCaptureContext.initialize( is present (v8 API)
DataCaptureContext.sharedInstance is used to obtain the context
new SparkScanSettings() is created and passed to new SparkScan(
Symbology.EAN13UPCA is enabled (mapped from 'ean-13')
Symbology.Code128 is enabled (mapped from 'code-128')
Symbology.QR is enabled (mapped from 'qr')
Symbology.QRCode does NOT appear as a Symbology enum value (the correct case is Symbology.QR)
addListener( is called on the SparkScan mode with a didScan callback
The didScan callback is declared async (the 8.6 SparkScanListener returns Promise<void>)
The didScan callback reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and does not loop over an array of codes
barcode.data is null-guarded before use
<SparkScanView is rendered with context, sparkScan and sparkScanViewSettings props
The scanned list and its 'Scanned: <count>' summary are rendered as children of <SparkScanView> (semantic)
The existing dedup behavior is preserved (a scanned value already in the list is not added again) (semantic)
PermissionsAndroid.request( is used for the camera permission (the old permission hook is gone)
The cleanup removes the listener and calls dataCaptureContext.removeMode( on unmount
dataCaptureContext.dispose() is NOT called anywhere in the code
Setup checklist mentions scandit-react-native-datacapture-core and scandit-react-native-datacapture-barcode
Setup checklist mentions npx pod-install for iOS
Setup checklist mentions NSCameraUsageDescription in the iOS Info.plist
A summary of changes is shown listing what vision-camera code was removed and what Scandit code was added, including the new SparkScan trigger-button UI as a change to confirm
